verdict.rationale: Phoenix's self-hosting (free, air-gapped, versioned Docker/K8s deployments) lets teams spin up an isolated instance instead of touching production, and datasets explicitly support collecting from 'production, staging, evaluations, and even manually,' implying separate environment support. However, there is no explicit documented 'sandbox mode,' synthetic/test-data tooling, or guidance on isolating a test instance from prod data flows. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment feature or guide, synthetic test-data generation, documented isolation guarantees between prod and test instances, independent confirmation of this workflow.
